sloka: तेषां प्रहारान् स चकार मोघान् रक्षोधिपो बाणगणैः शिताग्रैः ।तान् वानरेन्द्रानपि बाणजालैर्बिभेद जाम्बूनदचित्रपुङ्खैः ।। ६.५९.४३ ।।।।
transliteration: teṣāṁ prahārān sa cakāra moghān rakṣodhipo bāṇagaṇaiḥ śitāgraiḥ ।tān vānarendrānapi bāṇajālairbibheda jāmbūnadacitrapuṅkhaiḥ ।। 6.59.43 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa Lord made the mountain peaks useless by the hundreds of arrows released by him. The streams of arrows with golden shafts could resist the Rakshasas and strike the Vanara king.
